questions.question:
윗글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은? [4점]
ⓐ <u>Today, people enjoy taking selfies</u>. We can capture special moments with (A)<u>them</u>.
Long ago, people captured their own image in a different way. They painted pictures of themselves. (B)<u>These pictures</u> are self-portraits.
Selfies and self-portraits are similar.
(C)<u>Both</u> show our image at a certain time. ⓑ <u>When we look at them, we can remember ourselves from that time</u>. They are like a diary.
We take selfies to remember happy moments. Selfies capture the expressions on our faces at (D)<u>those times</u>. ⓒ <u>We often look at selfies with our family and friends to bring back those joyful feeling</u>.
( ㄱ ) Similarly, some painters made self-portraits to capture different times in their lives. ( ㄴ ) Rembrandt looked in the mirror and painted himself many times. ( ㄷ ) They show his face from youth to old age.
________________ (가) ________________.
Taking a selfie is easy. We can do it quickly with our camera at any time. However, painting a self-portrait takes some time. ⓓ <u>Also, a self-portrait shows painter's a personal painting style</u>.
To paint a person, a painter needs a model. ( ㄹ ) Vincent van Gogh didn't have enough money for a model. ( ㅁ ) So he painted himself! ⓔ <u>When he painted his self-portraits, he chose bright colors and applied a lot of paint</u>. This became his unique style. We can see (E)<u>it</u> in his other paintings too.
We can express ourselves with selfies and self-portraits. Do you want to try?
choices: ① Van Gogh's self-portraits have many bright colors.
② Taking a selfie is quick, but painting a self-portrait takes some time.
③ Rembrandt painted himself when he was young and when he was old.
④ We can remember special moments with selfies and self-portraits.
⑤ Rembrandt and Van Gogh painted themselves because they did not have enough money for models.

questions.question:
윗글의 내용과 일치하는 것은? [4점]
Reporter: Today is October 9, a special day for Hangeul, the Korean alphabet. I'm at a Hangeul festival now. People are enjoying fun activities here. ⓐ <u>They look happily and excited</u>. I'm going to interview three Hangeul lovers.
[ Pueng, 13, student, Thailand / Anna, 27, designer, Switzerland / William, 51, professor, Canada ]
Reporter: Here is my first question. ________ (가) ________?
Pueng: I like Hangeul because it is easy to learn. I learned the 24 letters of Hangeul, and I am able to read any Korean word now.
Anna: The shapes of Hangeul look unique and beautiful. I like the Korean word for Switzerland, "스위스[seu-wi-seu]." It looks like a soldier between two mountains. It looks great!
William: ⓑ <u>I like Hangeul because its history is amazing</u>. A long time ago, most Koreans couldn't read or write. King Sejong ________ (나) ________, so he created a new alphabet for his people.
Reporter: You all really love Hangeul! ⓒ <u>How did you start to learn it</u>?
Pueng: I'm a big fan of K-pop songs. Because I wanted to sing Korean songs, I started learning Hangeul. Now I can sing many K-pop songs!
Anna: ⓓ <u>I was interested in using Hangeul in my designs</u>. So I studied the shapes of Hangeul. I can make unique patterns for clothes with Hangeul.
William: I wanted to teach the science of Hangeul to my students. ⓔ <u>Some letters look like the shape of the mouth and tongue for their sounds</u>. King Sejong made it that way. It's very scientific.
Reporter: Thank you for sharing your stories. Enjoy this festival!
choices: ① Anna studied the shapes of Hangeul to write K-pop songs.
② William wanted to teach his students the science of Hangeul.
③ All three people started learning Hangeul to make unique designs.
④ King Sejong made Hangeul, so Korean people could learn many different languages.
⑤ Pueng started to learn Hangeul because she wanted to understand the history of Korean songs.
